text:
Nora (BD): Hi finance, reconciliation question. I took a vendor out to dinner in London for contract negotiations last week. I filed an expense but lost the itemized restaurant receipt. I did collect a credit card slip and the merchant imprint. I also took a £200 cash advance pre-trip. How do I reconcile without the full receipt?
expense-bot: Reminder: Missing receipts require manager attestation or vendor confirmation. Cash advances should be reconciled within 10 business days of trip completion.
Elaine (Finance): Hi Nora 3- we can accept a merchant attestation or a short vendor email confirming the date, total, and attendees if the original receipt is unavailable. The card slip plus a photo of the bill is ideal. For the cash advance, we need the remaining balance or a breakdown showing how the advance was spent.
Nora (BD): I have the CC slip (shows £186.40) and a photo of the table check with server handwriting that's partly smudged (amount matches). I don't have a formal VAT receipt. I also have a confirmation email from the vendor that lists attendees and says "dinner total £334.80" which includes two bottles of wine. The CC slip is the company card covering £186.40 and I paid the rest in cash out of the £200 advance.
Ben (Eng): quick Q: does the company reimburse alcohol? We had a vendor engagement line in policy but not sure about bottles of wine.
Rita (Manager): As the approver I confirm this meeting was business-related. Policy: client-facing meals are reimbursable; high-value alcohol may need justification. Please itemize on the expense form "client dinner - negotiation; 3 attendees; vendor: The Old Wharf" and note the wines. Approving the variance.
Elaine (Finance): Thanks Rita. Nora 3- please upload: 1) CC slip, 2) photo of the smudged bill, 3) vendor confirmation email, 4) brief note showing cash breakdown (advance £200: used £148.40 cash toward bill + £... receipts for taxis). We'll treat the two bottles of wine as reimbursable but we'll flag them as "non-essential alcohol" and code to BD-ENTERTAIN. Also mark how much of the advance remains so we can reconcile.
Nora (BD): Uploaded all items and added cash breakdown: advance £200 - cash used £148.40 (dinner) + £21.00 taxi + £5.60 tip = £175.00. Remaining £25 returned to petty cash (receipt for return attached).
expense-bot: Expense created: "Vendor dinner - London 07/2026" status: awaiting manager attestation and finance review. Link: https://expenses.internal/reports/EXP-3022
Elaine (Finance): Everything looks good. Because original VAT receipt is missing, I'll mark this as "accepted with vendor confirmation" and note for audit. We will disallow any future claims without VAT invoices for UK vendors over £250. Reimbursement scheduled: company card portion handled (no payout), cash advance settlement: £25 returned, no further payout. Case #FIN-2026-137.
Nora (BD): Thanks all. Sorry for the messy receipts 3 will ask vendors for proper VAT invoices moving forward.
Rita (Manager): Thanks Nora and Elaine 3 approved.
Elaine (Finance): Closing out. If auditors request more detail we'll follow up here. :white_check_mark:
